record.paper_title: Mathematical open problems in Projected Entangled Pair States
record.original_question: Let T be a primitive quantum channel acting on D by D matrices, where the primitivity index p(T) is the smallest positive integer n such that T raised to the n-th power sends every positive semidefinite input to a full-rank matrix. What is the exact best possible upper bound on p(T) as a function of D?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D\ge 2$ be an integer and let $T:M_D(\mathbb{C})\to M_D(\mathbb{C})$ be a completely positive, trace-preserving linear map (a quantum channel). Call $T$ primitive if there exists a positive integer $n$ such that for every nonzero positive semidefinite matrix $\rho\in M_D(\mathbb{C})$, the matrix $T^n(\rho)$ is positive definite (i.e. of full rank). For a primitive $T$ define the primitivity index $p(T)$ as the smallest such $n$. Let 
$$f(D)=\sup\{p(T): T \text{ is a primitive quantum channel on } M_D(\mathbb{C})\}.$$
Determine the exact value (or the exact asymptotic order) of $f(D)$ as a function of $D$. In particular, it is known that $f(D)=O(D^2\log D)$ and conjectured that $f(D)=\Theta(D^2)$; establish the best possible upper bound.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact optimal bound remains open. The best general upper bound is O(D^2 log D), while the conjectured optimum is O(D^2). Recent (2023–2025) work establishes bounds of order 2(D-1)^2 for primitive Schwarz/2-positive maps and Θ(log D) generic bounds, but the tight worst-case constant and exact rate for completely positive primitive channels is not yet determined.

status_evidence.title: A generic quantum Wielandt's inequality
status_evidence.snippet: Generically, k is of order Θ(log n); in the general case, the best bound to date is O(n^2 log n).
status_evidence.claim: Best known general bound is O(D^2 log D); conjectured Θ(D^2).

status_evidence.title: A note on the quantum Wielandt inequality
status_evidence.snippet: The index of primitivity of any primitive unital Schwarz map is at most 2(D-1)^2.
status_evidence.claim: Recent improvement gives 2(D-1)^2 bound for Schwarz maps, but optimal constant remains open.

status_evidence.title: A quantum version of Wielandt's inequality
status_evidence.snippet: Original quantum Wielandt inequality giving O(D^2 log D) bound, conjectures D^2.
status_evidence.claim: Original conjecture that the optimal bound is of order D^2.
